rationale: The interpreter output contains unresolved ambiguities regarding height units, valid ranges and precision, source and format of starting circuit values, and behavior when circuits are added or removed. These open questions prevent a complete and reliable implementation of the DX Coil Height calculation and must be clarified before proceeding.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify the units for circuit heights.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the height units (e.g., inches, centimeters).

findings.description: The ticket does not define valid height ranges or the required precision for circuit heights.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on acceptable height ranges (minimum/maximum) and the precision/rounding rules.

sourceRefs.quote: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify the source and format of the initial circuit height values.
findings.action: Clarify how the starting circuit heights are provided (e.g., default values, data import, user entry) and their data format.

sourceRefs.quote: The source and format of starting circuit values are unspecified.

findings.description: The ticket does not define behavior when circuits are added or removed after the initial population.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on how the system should handle addition or removal of cooling circuits and how the DX Coil Height should be updated accordingly.

sourceRefs.quote: Behavior when circuits are added or removed is unspecified.
